correctness.rationale: For any bivariate copula and integer k>=1, independent branch J gives F_k C=(jv+C(ku-j,v))/k. The a.e. conditional derivative repeats, preserving population xi; centered section F_v(t)=C(t,v)-tv is Lipschitz with zero endpoints. The least concave majorant of k repetitions has only first-rise and last-fall portions of the original envelope, joined by a maximal plateau; its derivative L2 energy scales by k. Combined with amplitude 1/k this proves xi^up(F_k C)=xi^up(C)/k; reflecting predictor gives xi^down likewise. Integration gives rho_S/k, and Frechet deviations |C-Pi|<=1/4 give uniform closeness <=1/(4k) with equality for comonotone. The proof handles singular copulas and k=1. Independent exact rational PAVA comparison of 6,723 centered profiles length 2..6 for fold factors 2,3,5 corroborated e(F_k)=e/k but finite sampling is not continuum proof.
